status: Frozen after28 host/Linux synthetic tests, actual kernel/timer probes and check/typecheck/build; before any live OSM request
requestContract: Unchanged21 QL/form hashes, bbox/order/snapshot. Exactly sequential status/query pairs, at most42 attempts. Direct stdlib HTTPS to fixed host/path, no inherited proxies/cookies/auth, no redirect/retry/poll/failover. All attempts enter ledger before I/O.
bodyCounters: Count payload bytes delivered by read1 or IncompleteRead.partial, including error/redirect/late bytes. Headers/TCP/TLS/kernel buffering are not claimed as metered body bytes. Spool received chunks before semantic validation. Reject oversized declared bodies without consuming them; streamed oversize retains the one-byte sentinel. Every consumed byte/file hash is independently reconciled.
deadlines: POSIX SIGALRM plus monotonic checks bound absolute acceptance through connection/header/body/normal close. No existing interval timer may be displaced. Independent process watchdog/host container timeout enforce global wall limit. Status waits are taken once from the returned slot time and never exceed30s/global remaining time.
nativeData: Strict JSON duplicate/nonfinite rejection; version0.6 and Overpass generator; fixed requested snapshot, base>=snapshot and element timestamp<=snapshot. Typed positive IDs/versions, complete raw tags, full selected-way node closure and bbox intersection including crossing/touching segments. Reject invisible/deleted elements. Restriction references are preserved but not resolved by new requests.
normalizationAndRowLimits: Accepted native-element/normalized-extract limits are checked before committing excess output. The bounded response is decoded before logical row counts are known. Validated occurrence counts can exceed their limit in a stopped attempt, and malformed responses have unknown logical counts; neither is complete/admitted. Every complete capture stays within all limits. Raw rejected bodies and any valid normalized prefix remain preserved. No silent truncation/counter reset.
identity: Snapshot+typed ID+version+canonical native-field hash. A way also binds every ordered native node record/version/coordinate through a geometry dependency hash. Conflicting duplicates stop before committing that window. Optional editor attribution is retained in raw response hashes, not required in normalized records.
auditor: Separate native-field/count/closure/dependency reconstruction, exact normalized prefix/body/file/window/ledger/deadline/status-wait checks. Shared JSON/time/hash primitives only, no call to primary batch/normalize. Handles complete and softly stopped captures. Hard kill/OOM/audit failure preserves last state/raw files; driver admits nothing and warns counters may be partial.
scope: Capture/metadata inventory only; no semantic speed/access source adapter, usable-limit classification, matcher, graph arrays, routing/ETA query or model admission. Empty result means empty source-query result, not road absence. Original21 incomplete Overture windows,2.827 baseline provisional km and all original model/feasibility gates remain unchanged.
